verdict.rationale: Aleph documents a conversational agent that users can tag in Slack to ask questions. It keeps context across follow-ups, pulls and reasons over data, and updates existing reports and dashboards or builds new ones from scratch. Agent mappings are also configured through plain natural-language prompts with no coding. Missing for 10: any independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor marketing copy), and documentation of how far natural-language control extends to other product areas such as connectors, planning models, permissions and admin.
